description:
Welcome to this exceptional value opportunity in the heart of Tarzana. As of the list date, this is the lowest-priced 2-bedroom condo available in Tarzana, offering an incredible chance for homeowners and investors alike. Recent model-match sales in the same community closed at significantly higher prices, highlighting the outstanding value this home presents.
Privately situated on the second floor, this light-filled 2-bedroom, 2-bath residence offers a comfortable and functional layout with tasteful updates throughout. The spacious living and dining areas flow seamlessly together, creating an inviting atmosphere for both everyday living and entertaining. The updated kitchen features modern finishes and ample cabinetry, while both bathrooms have been refreshed with contemporary touches. Smooth ceilings, central HVAC, and abundant natural light enhance the home’s clean and airy feel.
The generously sized primary suite includes its own private bathroom and ample closet space, while the second bedroom is ideal for guests, a home office, or flexible living needs. Additional highlights include two parking spaces in the secured parking garage and a desirable location within the community.
Conveniently located near Ventura Boulevard’s popular restaurants, shopping, cafes, and easy freeway access, this is an outstanding opportunity to own a move-in ready condo in one of the San Fernando Valley’s most sought-after neighborhoods.
